sql.query: SELECT gc.pdfStoragePath,gc.pdfFileName FROM tbl_generated_contracts gc WHERE gc.id=:id AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId AND gc.status IN ('issued','sent') AND gc.pdfStoragePath IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='CONTRACT_GENERATION' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) LIMIT 1
